questions.question: Which evidence most directly supports a correct resume?
options: The next and later complete training states match a compatible uninterrupted run
questions.explanation: Recovery preserves a continuation, so the first resumed update and subsequent state are the relevant evidence. Startup and a finite scalar loss are much weaker.
optionFeedback: Starting a process does not show correct continuation. Compare the next batches, state and losses with an uninterrupted baseline.
Recovery preserves a continuation, so the first resumed update and subsequent state are the relevant evidence. Startup and a finite scalar loss are much weaker.
A finite loss can belong to a different trajectory. Test state equality and several subsequent updates at the same boundary.
